chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Al-Washshāʾ, from Al-Khaybarī, from Yūnus ibn Ẓabyān, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

I heard him saying: Had Allah, Blessed and Exalted, not created Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام for Fāṭimah, there would not have been any equal match for her upon the face of the earth, from Ādam and those below him.

key_terms.آدَمَ: Adam عليه السلام, the first human being
key_terms.أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the title of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.ظَهْرِ الْأَرْضِ: the surface or face of the earth
key_terms.فَاطِمَةَ: Fāṭimah عليها السلام, daughter of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.كُفْوٌ: an equal, counterpart, or suitable match

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the unique match between Fāṭimah عليها السلام and Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the unique and unparalleled status of Fāṭimah عليها السلام and Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام in creation. It presents their union as divinely ordained, indicating that no other person from among humanity would have been a suitable equal for her.
